proof: Choose the original first crease horizontal. Original longitudinal ray has angle alpha=70 degrees. After the first reflection the two downward arm rays are L=180+alpha=250 and R=360-alpha=290; the small central isosceles triangle apex is180-2alpha=40. In the shown next folds each downward arm is reflected about the other original side of that central triangle. Reflection formula theta_new=2phi-theta gives left output2L-R=3alpha=210 and right output2R-L=540-3alpha=330. Their shown lower opening is330-210=540-6alpha=120, three times40; only C. The fold axes are the existing two sides of the central triangle, not invented right angles or an angle measured from pixels.
wrong_rule: Copy the supplementary angle adjacent to alpha,180-70=110, onto beta, forgetting the two subsequent reflections.
